class.name: ImpostorField3D
class.brief_description: Far-distance impostor LOD ring drawn as one MultiMesh.
class.description: [ImpostorField3D] continues a set of mesh placements past the draw distance of the real meshes. Each placement becomes a camera-facing quad textured from a baked [CgameImpostorBaker] atlas, so distant hills keep their bushes and trees instead of popping to bare ground. All placements are drawn with a single [MultiMesh] and one draw call. The field is visible between [member mesh_range] and [code]mesh_range * range factor[/code] (see [method configure]), with distance fade controlled by [member fade_margin]. It stays hidden until its atlas has been baked; baking starts as soon as the field is inside the scene tree. Performance quality ([code]level == 0[/code]) uses a range factor of [code]0[/code] and draws no impostors: [method rebuild] and [method add] then do nothing. [codeblock] ImpostorField3D.configure(2) var field := ImpostorField3D.add(chunk_node, bush_mesh, bush_transforms, 60.0) [/codeblock]

method.name: add
method.description: Creates a field for [param mesh] at the given [param transforms], configures its ranges, builds it and adds it to [param parent]. Returns [code]null[/code] when nothing would be drawn: no parent, mesh or transforms, or a range factor of [code]1.0[/code] or less.

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets the global range factor from a quality level between [code]0[/code] and [code]3[/code]: [code]0.0[/code], [code]1.8[/code], [code]2.2[/code] and [code]2.8[/code]. Applies to fields built afterwards.

method.name: end_distance
method.description: Returns the distance at which impostors fade out for a mesh that is visible up to [param mesh_range], using the current range factor.

method.name: get_range_factor
method.description: Returns the current impostor range factor relative to the mesh range.

method.name: is_baked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the atlas has been baked and the field is visible.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Builds the [MultiMesh], custom bounds, visibility ranges and shadow settings from [member source_mesh], [member placements], [member mesh_range] and [member fade_margin]. The field is hidden until baked. Returns [code]false[/code] and clears the multimesh when nothing would be drawn.

members.member: Width of the distance fade at the start of the visibility range. The fade at the end is twice as wide.
Distance up to which the real mesh is drawn. Impostors start here.
World placements of every instance. Call [method rebuild] after changing them.
The mesh that is baked into impostors.
